IN PHOTOS: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon inspects the ongoing drainage rehabilitation project along Bonifacio Drive in Manila, April 13, 2026. He expressed confidence that the nearly 200-meter project will be completed on schedule by May after conducting a site inspection earlier in the day. The project involves doubling the size of drainage pipes to help ease flooding in key areas including Burgos Avenue, Bonifacio Drive, and Roxas Boulevard. Dizon also noted that the inner lane has been reinforced to withstand the heavy load of passing trailer trucks. 

📸: Norman Cruz

Delhi Traffic Police issues a traffic advisory after workers’ protest over a wage hike turns violent in Noida:

"Traffic at Noida severely affected due to on going agitation by the workers from private factories. They have completely blocked Noida Link Road coming from Chilla Border (Delhi). Traffic movement towards Noida from the Chilla Border is severely affected.
Public is hereby advised to plan their journey accordingly and use DND for travelling to Noida..."
